authors.name: Institute of RIA Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of industry researchers covers RIA formation, compliance, and technology stacks.

editorial.how_we_test: We conduct reproducible, published back-testing of AI stock-picking tools and technology stacks. All methodologies are published.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We generate revenue through vendor referrals and sponsorship from RIA-serving vendors. Commission links carry rel="sponsored nofollow" with plain-language disclosures.
editorial.corrections: Corrections to factual errors will be published promptly with a note detailing the change and the date it was made.
